description: Image Description: The image shows the rear section of a motorcycle, focusing on the license plate area. The motorcycle has a sleek, dark blue body with a glossy finish, reflecting light and surroundings. The rear fender curves smoothly over the back wheel, which is partially visible. Mounted centrally on the fender is a white license plate with the word "MINNESOTA" printed in blue at the top. Below it, the plate features an artistic design composed of various blue geometric shapes, resembling abstract snow
